representative-profile-mixed-train01.scope: Representative TimedDAG LibTorch prefill; identical screen model and limits; construction + one continued warmup + one measured step; two windows per step. Instrumented timings are excluded from throughput comparisons.

limits: Task durations may overlap across streams/devices; the sum is not wall time.
Host API levels can nest; never add them into an end-to-end total.
Scope/warmup must come from the launch record; no full-size extrapolation.
AiCPU is on the accelerator, distinct from host CPU and AiCore.

scope: TimedDAG, standalone LibTorch, online prefill; representative D128/B8/T4; five FP32 presets + separately reported resident FP16; three independent serial process repeats per cell.
limits: CPU baseline and host use one ATen/node worker. Not a tuned multi-core CPU limit.
Shared server; advisory NPU leases and serial own jobs do not exclude unrelated system load.
FP16 changes event counts and loss; no claim of an identical FP32 trajectory.
Event/output/cut/loss checks supplement earlier complete-observable semantic gates.
No full-size, other family/schedule/client, CUDA, or other CANN qualification.
